mapper.select: SELECT c.challenge_id FROM challenge c WHERE c.end_date < CURDATE() AND c.challenge_status <> 'ENDED' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.challenge_id

SELECT p.id AS payment_id, p.order_id, p.payment_key, cu.user_id, cu.challenge_id, p.amount, c.entry_fee, c.start_date FROM challenge_user cu JOIN challenge c ON c.challenge_id = cu.challenge_id JOIN payment p ON p.challenge_id = cu.challenge_id AND p.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE cu.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND cu.success_day >= c.goal_day AND cu.is_refunded = FALSE AND p.status = 'PAID' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM challenge_user cu JOIN challenge c ON c.challenge_id = cu.challenge_id JOIN payment p ON p.challenge_id = cu.challenge_id AND p.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE cu.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND cu.success_day >= c.goal_day AND cu.is_refunded = FALSE AND p.status = 'PAID' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
